bundle.shortDescription: Use your Android phone as a webcam
bundle.longDescription: CamDroid Studio turns an Android phone into a webcam and microphone for your desktop. Linux builds can publish to v4l2loopback and PulseAudio; Windows and macOS builds run as a standalone preview and camera controller.
